reels.title: Multimodal Flow: Unified Flow Modeling of Language and Vision in Embedding Spaces

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper represents a fundamental shift in generative models by moving from discrete tokens to continuous flow, which has high visual potential for 3Blue1Brown-style chalkboard animations. As a 'Multimodal Diffusion' topic, it boasts a 1.33x performance multiplier, making it highly valuable for YouTube Shorts.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if instead of predicting the next word, an AI could simply 'pour' your ideas into reality?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Instead of a digital painter placing dots one by one, imagine a smooth, flowing stream of paint that naturally shapes itself into a perfect landscape.
